collection.limits: Demonstration records only; no Amazon account, ASIN, customer, or review data was used.

reviews.title: Clip slides after a few minutes
reviews.text: The airflow is useful, but the clip slowly slides down on a vertical vent during a long drive.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 01
reviews.summary_zh: 垂直出风口使用时夹具会逐渐下滑。
reviews.translation_zh: 风量有用，但长途驾驶时夹具会在垂直出风口上慢慢下滑。

reviews.title: Needs more grip
reviews.text: The jaws are wide enough, yet the smooth pads do not hold firmly when the road is rough.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 02
reviews.summary_zh: 夹垫过于光滑，颠簸路面固定不稳。
reviews.translation_zh: 夹口宽度足够，但光滑夹垫在颠簸路面上抓不牢。

reviews.title: Good fan, weak hinge
reviews.text: The fan works, but the hinge cannot keep the selected angle when the car vibrates.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 03
reviews.summary_zh: 车辆振动时转轴无法保持角度。
reviews.translation_zh: 风扇可以工作，但车辆振动时转轴无法保持设定角度。

reviews.title: Buzzing at the lowest setting
reviews.text: Low speed has a noticeable buzz that is more distracting than the road noise at night.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 04
reviews.summary_zh: 最低档存在明显嗡鸣，夜间更干扰。
reviews.translation_zh: 低速档有明显嗡鸣，夜间甚至比路噪更让人分心。

reviews.title: Rattle near the dashboard
reviews.text: The motor is acceptable, but the housing rattles when the fan is angled toward the driver.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 05
reviews.summary_zh: 朝向驾驶员时外壳会产生共振。
reviews.translation_zh: 电机声音可以接受，但风扇朝向驾驶员时外壳会发出 rattling 声。

reviews.title: Cable does not reach the rear seat
reviews.text: The included cable is too short for the second row in a compact SUV unless I add an extension.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 06
reviews.summary_zh: 线材无法覆盖紧凑型 SUV 第二排。
reviews.translation_zh: 附带线材对紧凑型 SUV 第二排来说太短，除非额外使用延长线。

reviews.title: Limited placement options
reviews.text: I can mount it near the front outlet, but the cable length rules out the passenger headrest.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 07
reviews.summary_zh: 线长限制了头枕位置安装。
reviews.translation_zh: 可以装在前排电源附近，但线长不足以安装到乘客头枕。

reviews.title: The power requirement should be clearer
reviews.text: The quick guide did not make it obvious that the fan has no battery and must stay connected to USB power.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 08
reviews.summary_zh: 说明书未明确无电池且需持续 USB 供电。
reviews.translation_zh: 快速指南没有清楚说明风扇不带电池，必须持续连接 USB 电源。

reviews.title: Moves air across the whole front seat
reviews.text: Medium speed reaches both the driver and passenger without needing the highest setting.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 09
reviews.summary_zh: 中档风量可覆盖前排两侧。
reviews.translation_zh: 无需开到最高档，中档风量就能覆盖驾驶员和乘客。

reviews.title: Helpful during summer traffic
reviews.text: It circulates enough air to make stop-and-go traffic more comfortable before the cabin cools down.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 10
reviews.summary_zh: 夏季堵车时可在空调起效前改善体感。
reviews.translation_zh: 在车厢降温前，它能提供足够空气循环，让夏季走走停停的路况更舒适。

reviews.title: Good reach for a small fan
reviews.text: The focused stream reaches the rear-facing child seat when I aim it between the front seats.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 11
reviews.summary_zh: 小体积下仍可将定向风送到后向儿童座椅。
reviews.translation_zh: 把风扇朝向前排座椅中间时，集中气流可以到达后向儿童座椅。

reviews.title: Strong enough for a parked van
reviews.text: At full speed it moves noticeably more air than the small vent alone while loading equipment.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 12
reviews.summary_zh: 装卸设备时高档风量明显强于原车小出风口。
reviews.translation_zh: 装卸设备时开到最高档，它带来的气流明显强于小出风口本身。

reviews.title: Useful airflow for a pet crate
reviews.text: The narrow stream is easy to aim toward a small pet crate without blowing papers around the cabin.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 13
reviews.summary_zh: 定向气流适合宠物箱且不会吹乱车内物品。
reviews.translation_zh: 窄幅气流容易对准小型宠物箱，又不会把车厢里的纸张吹得到处都是。

reviews.title: Three speeds are genuinely different
reviews.text: Each speed changes the airflow enough to match city driving, highway driving, and parked use.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 14
reviews.summary_zh: 三档风量差异清晰，可覆盖不同驾驶状态。
reviews.translation_zh: 三个档位的气流变化足够明显，可以分别适配城市、高速和停车使用。

reviews.title: Installed without tools
reviews.text: The clip opened wide enough and I had the fan positioned in less than a minute.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 15
reviews.summary_zh: 无需工具，一分钟内即可完成安装。
reviews.translation_zh: 夹口张开范围足够，我不到一分钟就完成了风扇定位。

reviews.title: Easy to move between cars
reviews.text: I can remove it from one vehicle and attach it to another without changing any hardware.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 16
reviews.summary_zh: 无需更换配件即可在车辆间迁移。
reviews.translation_zh: 无需更换任何硬件，就能从一辆车拆下并安装到另一辆车。

reviews.title: Does not block the windshield
reviews.text: The small housing fits below my sightline and leaves the navigation screen visible.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 17
reviews.summary_zh: 小型机身不遮挡视线与导航屏。
reviews.translation_zh: 小型外壳位于视线下方，也不会挡住导航屏。

reviews.title: Fits in limited dashboard space
reviews.text: It leaves room for my phone mount and charging cable in a small hatchback.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 18
reviews.summary_zh: 在小型车内仍能为手机支架和充电线留出空间。
reviews.translation_zh: 在小型两厢车里，它仍为手机支架和充电线留出了空间。

reviews.title: Quiet enough on medium
reviews.text: Medium speed gives useful airflow without covering normal conversation in the car.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 19
reviews.summary_zh: 中档风量不会盖过车内正常交谈。
reviews.translation_zh: 中档既有实用风量，也不会盖过车内的正常交谈声。

reviews.title: Works with a standard power bank
reviews.text: USB power lets me use the fan outside the car with the power bank I already carry.
reviews.author: Synthetic Reviewer 20
reviews.summary_zh: 可连接已有充电宝在车外使用。
reviews.translation_zh: USB 供电让我可以连接随身携带的充电宝，在车外使用风扇。
